thesis_rationale: Proposed official config (500 opps / 100 customers / 30-day window) shows 0 portfolio conflicts and 0 B3/REVIVE differing across 18 cells — greedy raw ENRV equals Lagrangian selection. Legitimate 21-day-window variants show 195 total differing allocations and thousands of portfolio conflicts. Binding resource at 30d is retry_slots only; message/contact/human do not bind. M8 implementation audit: ALIGNED. Root cause: benchmark configuration + homogeneous mid-cycle candidate pool, not allocator defect.
